name: wait-shell
description: Lists the shell commands a Claude Code turn ran, while it runs and after: a count on the status line, then the commands above the prompt. Read-only and local. Never blocks or reruns a command.

enabled.title: List the shell commands a turn ran
enabled.description: On by default. A status-line count while a turn runs shell commands, and the list above the prompt. Only a list: nothing is blocked, rerun or sent. Off leaves every turn silent.
